career_ladder.note: Ranks and promotion timelines apply across the five Central Armed Police Forces (BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, and SSB) under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Officers begin as company commanders and advance to battalion, sector, and frontier commands. Promotion intervals are based on MHA time-scale norms and cadre reviews.

exam_scheme.note: The CAPF (Assistant Commandants) examination is conducted by UPSC in three stages: Written Examination (two papers, 450 marks total), Physical Standards / Physical Efficiency Tests (PST/PET) and Medical Standards Tests (qualifying nature), and Personality Test / Interview (150 marks). Final merit list is determined out of a grand total of 600 marks (450 written + 150 interview). In Paper I objective questions, one-third (0.33) marks penalty applies for each incorrect response.

financial_package.estimate_note: Base Level 10 calculation (₹56,100 + 58% DA). Officers deployed in field operational areas, Left-Wing Extremism (LWE) corridors, or High Altitude / Border zones receive additional Risk & Hardship Allowances (up to ₹17,300 to ₹25,000 per month depending on matrix cell).
official_perks: Government accommodation / family quarters inside battalion campus or HRA
Risk & Hardship Allowance (RHA) for operational postings
Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / free field ration
Medical facilities through Composite Hospital / CGHS network for self and dependents
Central Police Canteen (CPC) tax-subsidized purchasing benefits
Dress / Uniform allowance and annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
